paragraphs.source_en: The willow groves are fresh and green, the south wind blows and smells sweet, casting strange peaks and jade-like isles into a dream. All day long, golden clouds and white clouds drift, and out there, amid the rippling wheat, there are peasant women, speaking in deep, bustling laughter. Their laughter rises in rich murmurs— ask whether the peas in the back garden are still fat and healthy, ask whether any birds come to steal the yangmei; It has not rained for several days, yet the roses have not yet turned fully red; Lady Mei has gone into the city today; let us see whether she has brought any news. Their laughter gathers again— "Our household is in good shape now, we have already gone back to work as usual, no longer idling all day, no longer making a drunken show, we now return home with talk and laughter, attentive to our children—loving our wife;" "Ah!" "What a fortunate coincidence!" Look over there—hair all disheveled, coming this way, laughing gleefully— is that not him? (Laughter!) "His whole body is covered in mud!" The south wind blows gently, the plants are all green, and the ground is filled with warm sunshine. The sky is all white clouds and gold-brown clouds, and in those waves of wheat farmers and farm wives keep laughing and talking.

「我們家的如今好了，

已經照常上工去，

不再整天的無聊，

不再逞酒使氣，

回家來有說有笑，

疼他兒女——愛他妻；

可不是他，（哈哈！）滿身是泥！」
